issue.title: Python filesystem workflow loaders miss sharded ace-run timestamps
issue.description:
## Bug

- **Location:** `src/sase/ace/tui/models/_loaders/_workflow_loaders.py:_iter_workflow_timestamp_dirs`

`_iter_workflow_timestamp_dirs` only walks `~/.sase/projects/*/artifacts/<workflow-dir>/<timestamp>/`. Production hosts write the sharded `<YYYYMM>/<DD>/<timestamp>` layout, so the Python filesystem workflow loaders return nothing against real artifacts.

ACE does not depend on this walk for the Agents tab (the tiered path uses the Rust scanner and its bounded fallback). The compatibility exports in `_done_loaders.py` / `_workflow_loaders.py` still advertise a fallback that cannot work on a sharded tree.

Found while implementing `plan:202608/pending_gate_shells.md`; out of scope for that tale.

task_type_fields.impact: Compatibility exports in _done_loaders.py / _workflow_loaders.py advertise a filesystem fallback that cannot see any real host's sharded tree. ACE's live path is fine (Rust scanner), so this is not the pending-gate-shell visibility bug; callers of the Python filesystem walk still get an empty set.
task_type_fields.repro:
Write a production-shaped artifact at ~/.sase/projects/

/artifacts/ace-run//

//workflow_state.json and call load_workflow_states() / get_workflow_timestamp_dirs(). The iterator yields nothing because it only walks one directory level under the workflow dir.
